name: Modality Pipeline Onboarding
description: End-to-end onboarding of a new modality pipeline: analyze, graph, persist, link, and verify retrieval — the exact arc text/code/math followed.

steps.description: Design the modality pipeline: the Analyze, CreateGraph and QueryGraph actions it needs and how it persists to ZSEI for real (no stubs). Produce the design and a build checklist. Building and running the binary needs a build capability this system does not have registered; the capability is recorded.
steps.name: design_pipeline

steps.description: Specify how CreateGraph persists a real ModalityGraph container keyed by container id under the project, and what the container and graph file must contain. Hands on the container id and graph file expectations.
steps.name: persist_container

steps.description: Specify the linking step: link_to_existing walks the relationship neighborhood (hop-ordered, uncapped) and wires bidirectional SimilarTo edges with provenance. Hands on the edges the step must write.
steps.name: link_relationships

steps.description: State the cross-process proof: QueryGraph from a fresh process must return the persisted graph, non-empty. Hands on the verification procedure and the pass condition. Running it needs a fresh-process test capability that is not registered.
steps.name: verify_retrieval

missing_capabilities: build and run a modality pipeline binary (cargo build, Analyze/CreateGraph/QueryGraph actions)
run a test or fresh-process verification against the host (e.g. QueryGraph from a new process, a regression test run)
